proposed_rules.trigger: A 'Pre-Built Templates' zone with slider/carousel Previous/Next controls (text runs together as 'PreviousNe...' in capture) showcasing app template cards.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a dedicated 'template-carousel' block with one row per template card, plus prev/next affordances handled by the block's decorate JS (not authored per-row). Alternatives considered: modeling as a plain repeating-cards grid (rejected - loses the carousel/slider interaction semantics visible in the source); modeling nav controls as separate default-content links (rejected - they are block chrome, not page content).
proposed_rules.rationale: Distinct from the generic repeating-cards-are-one-block case because of the slider navigation controls; recurs on solution pages featuring a template gallery.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [2x1] 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA heading + link row appears as a separate top-level row (rc2) below the main content wrapper.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a site-wide footer fragment/CTA, not per-page default-content or block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text/position recurs across solution, integration, and FAQ templates. Alternative considered: per-page default-content (rejected, duplicative).
